# Development Guide — ts-fullstack-app

## 1. Setup & Requirements
- Target Language: `typescript`
- Repository Hosting: `github`

## 2. Standard Commands
- **Compile / Build:** `npm run build`
- **Execute Test Suite:** `npm test`
- **Local Dev Server / Runner:** `npm run dev`
- **Linter & Code Format:** `npm run lint`

## 3. Pull Request & Verification Checklist
1. Ensure all tests pass locally: `npm test`.
2. Confirm code passes static analysis with zero errors: `npm run lint`.
3. Adhere to guardrails declared in [`PROJECT_GUARDRAILS.md`](../PROJECT_GUARDRAILS.md).
